name: clair-obscur-themes
description: Shared Clair and Obscur palettes for browser and client themes, with a Garmin watch face candidate, phone icons and documented acceptance limits.

paragraphs: Two appearances built around black and white. Clair uses a white background with black lettering and symbols. Obscur uses a black background with white lettering and symbols. Neutral gray separates secondary information. The current app icons and watch-face source use this palette, with Inter where the host supports it and native font fallbacks elsewhere. Preserved desktop packages still use their earlier colors and versions.

This is an experimental preview. Both themes have limited native Equibop evidence for loading, matching and opposite appearances, switching and scoped restoration. Obscur and Clair 0.1.1 each installed in the retained isolated ordinary Chrome profile, with only the recorded interface surfaces inspected. Complete native interface and typography coverage, Chrome switching, removal and cleanup remain open. The webpage specimen is not a screenshot of either application's interface. See the compatibility and acceptance record for the observed surfaces and remaining checks.
